correctness.rationale: Reconstructed nested labeled circular gap decomposition, including zero-length gaps and fixed coordinate/index tie order. For each old gap, its b short-old indicator, r newly inserted labels and s short subgaps imply g >= (1-b)a/N + r(1-eps)a/M - sa/M by four exact cases; summing, using B/N<=R_N/2 and S/M<=R_M/2, yields the stated finite bound. Optimizing eps(1-eps)/(1+eps) at sqrt(2)-1 gives 3-2sqrt(2) and hence the limsup lower bound. Independent separate rational point generator tested 5,805 exact N,M,a cases with coincidences. Finite tests corroborate but do not establish the universal quantifiers.
